description: Change one cell of a Jupyter notebook (.ipynb): replace its source, insert a new cell, or delete it. Name the cell by cellId, or by index (0-based) when it has no id, as read shows them. Everything else in the notebook is kept. Replacing a code cell's source clears its outputs.

cellId.description: Id of the cell to change (insert: the new cell goes after it)

index.description: 0-based index of the cell, instead of cellId

mode.description: Defaults to replace. Insert without a cell adds the new cell first.

cellType.description: Type of an inserted cell (default code), or a new type for the replaced cell
